description: Real h11 case from live run 6 (Gemma 4.6B). The hunk removes 8 lines (embedding family comment, Nimbus comment, embeddingType pref, blank, dev/debug comment, two ml.embedGen prefs, blank). Upstream 155.0.1 has changed vs the patch base: the Nimbus comment now mentions 'empty (or invalid)', a new line about region/locale/OS was added, the embeddingType default changed from 'static' to '', and multilingual embedding region prefs (lines 749-752 in the file) are new upstream content not in the original patch.
